allow: Bash(pnpm exec vouchington agent-blackboard distill classify *)

hooks.command: b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); echo "Branch: ${b:-detached}"; echo "Status:"; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; echo "Recent commits:"; git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null; echo; gh pr view --json number,title,isDraft 2>/dev/null | jq -r '"PR: #" + (.number | tostring) + " " + .title + " (" + (if .isDraft then "draft" else "ready" end) + ")"' 2>/dev/null || true
pnpm exec vouchington tmux agent-reminder session-start

repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; cli="$repo/node_modules/vouchington-tooling/bin/vouchington.mjs"; if [ -f "$cli" ]; then help="$(node "$cli" --help)" || exit $?; case "$help" in *"agent-blackboard session-start"*) exec node "$cli" agent-blackboard session-start --docs-path docs/development/agent-blackboard.md --setup-hint "Run ./dev/initialize monorepo from the Vouchington worktree root, then continue this session." ;; esac; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"vouchington-tooling session-start is unavailable in this worktree. Run ./dev/initialize monorepo from the Vouchington worktree root, then continue this session."}}'

node "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/node_modules/vouchington-tooling/bin/vouchington.mjs" hook pre-tool-use --harness claude --policy "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/dev/codex-hooks/policy.mts" --root "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .toolInput.file_path // .toolInput.filePath // .toolInput.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.mjs|*.js|*.jsx) pnpm exec oxlint --type-aware --fix --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .toolInput.file_path // .toolInput.filePath // .toolInput.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.mjs|*.js|*.jsx) pnpm exec oxlint --type-aware "$f" 2>&1 || true ;; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .toolInput.file_path // .toolInput.filePath // .toolInput.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.mjs|*.js|*.jsx) pnpm exec oxfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .toolInput.file_path // .toolInput.filePath // .toolInput.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts) repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; rel="${f#"$repo_root"/}"; case "$rel" in backend/*) cd "$repo_root" && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental --project backend/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null ;; email-templates/*) cd "$repo_root" && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental --project email-templates/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null ;; web/*) cd "$repo_root" && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental --project web/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null ;; cloudflare-worker/*) cd "$repo_root" && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental --project cloudflare-worker/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null ;; lambdas/*) cd "$repo_root" && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental --project lambdas/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null ;; ts-shared/*) cd "$repo_root" && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental --project ts-shared/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null ;; *) cd "$repo_root" && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental --project tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null ;; esac || true ;; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .toolInput.file_path // .toolInput.filePath // .toolInput.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; case "$f" in *.md) [ -n "$f" ] && path="$f" && case "$path" in "$repo_root"/*) path="${path#"$repo_root"/}";; esac && (cd "$repo_root" && "$repo_root/ci/lint-links.sh" --offline "$path" 2>/dev/null) || true ;; esac
f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .toolInput.file_path // .toolInput.filePath // .toolInput.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .toolInput.file_path // .toolInput.filePath // .toolInput.path // empty" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.lua) selene --config selene.toml "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

node "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/node_modules/vouchington-tooling/bin/vouchington.mjs" hook post-tool-use --harness claude --policy "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/dev/codex-hooks/policy.mts" --root "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" 2>&1 || true

node "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/node_modules/vouchington-tooling/bin/vouchington.mjs" hook post-tool-use --harness claude --policy "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/dev/codex-hooks/policy.mts" --root "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" 2>/dev/null || true
pnpm exec vouchington tmux agent-reminder user-prompt
